spec_case: issue #674: a mid-stream disconnect retries like any other dropped connection
description: The mock server closes the connection after two NDJSON deltas, before the `done: true` line; the attempt fails (curl's premature-EOF exit, classified retryable the same as a dropped connection) and the retry's fresh request gets a complete reply. Curl's own text (the exact byte count read before the drop) never reaches the final state outside `meta.attempts`, where the first (failed) attempt's own text is matched by pattern (third_party_text), not byte-for-byte.

third_party_text.pattern: ollama request failed \(curl exit 18\) model='test-model' url=http://127\.0\.0\.1:<MOCK_PORT>/api/generate: curl: \(18\) transfer closed with 95 bytes remaining to read.*
